pricing_faq_4_q: What time does the email SLA fire?
pricing_faq_4_a: You set timezone and HH:MM in settings. The briefing email is the SLA — not morning-only.
pricing_faq_5_q: Is WhatsApp part of the SLA?
pricing_faq_5_a: No. WhatsApp is optional and best-effort. Email is the committed channel.
pricing_faq_6_a: Act needs a human move and an evidence pointer (file section, IPC clause, schedule row). Without a pointer it stays Watch or quiet.
pricing_faq_7_q: Pilot vs project pack — which first?
pricing_faq_7_a: Start with Pilot on live jobs. Add a project pack when you need more active slots at AED 400/project/mo.
pricing_faq_8_q: Do you support Arabic and RTL?
pricing_faq_8_a: Yes. Switch locale in the product; layout flips RTL and copy switches to Arabic.
pricing_faq_9_q: Can I cancel after the pilot?
pricing_faq_9_a: Yes. Monthly AED after proof is cancel-friendly. Use the customer portal or talk to the founder.
pricing_faq_10_q: What do the agents actually do?
pricing_faq_10_a: They read uploaded or forwarded project files and draft Act / Watch with evidence. They do not invent text when the file has none.
